title: The Current That Remembers Asphalt

features.name: the road that became water
features.desc-on-touch: You walk the current and feel the ghost of asphalt underneath. The water here flows in the exact pattern the traffic used to.

features.name: surface marking
features.desc-on-touch: Pale lines beneath the water. Lane markings that learned to hold in the current. The road remembers its own edges.

features.name: the contour that drives
features.desc-on-touch: A current that winds the way roads did. Both path and passage. The water learned the road's whole route and now travels it.

features.name: speed made liquid
features.desc-on-touch: The flow here moves where vehicles used to move. The water holds the memory of velocity. You cannot swim against this current.

features.name: destination forgotten
features.desc-on-touch: Addresses dissolve in water. The road knew where to go; the current has learned to go everywhere and nowhere at once.

inscription: the road surrendered to water and found that both were the same journey written in different grammars

file.name: Road_Route_2146_Submersion_Recording.mp3
file.note: 50 minutes: vehicle sounds morphing gradually into water flow. The boundary between them is unmarked.

reverie.title: REVERIE — where the asphalt learned to flow
narr: you sat together watching the road blur beneath.
she said: the road is just water learning one way.
the rain came, or the river rose between you.
the boundary between them dissolved, and so did paths.
you both sat still. the asphalt flowed away.
